columns.name: CONTENT_ID
columns.description: System generated unique identifier.

columns.name: CONTENT_TYPE
columns.description: Polymorphic discriminator column { DOCUMENT, VIDEO, TUTORIAL ... }.

columns.name: MEDIA_TYPE
columns.description: Content media type based on Internet media type.

columns.name: CREATED_BY_ID
columns.description: Indicates the person identifier who created the content object.

columns.name: DELETED_BY_ID
columns.description: Indicates the person identifier who deleted the content object.

columns.name: DELETED_DATE
columns.description: Indicates the date and time of the deletion of the content object.

columns.name: OWNED_BY_ID
columns.description: Indicates the person identifier who ownes the content object.

columns.name: VISIBILITY
columns.description: Visibility of the content object {PUBLIC, PRIVATE, UNLISTED}.

columns.name: PERMISSION
columns.description: An user permission(s) on the content object {SHARE}.

columns.name: LOCATION
columns.description: Information about location of the content object.

columns.name: CATEGORY
columns.description: Category of the content object.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Current status of the content object {ACTIVE, DELETED}.

columns.name: THUMBNAIL_ID
columns.description: Thumbnail associated with the content object.

columns.name: DURATION
columns.description: Video section duration or description duration for non-video section.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of Enterprise, used for multi-tenancy partitioning. Foreign key to HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
